workflow.label: Draft first
workflow.description: Published article files are never edited directly. Create a draft copy first.

workflow.label: Preview before publish
workflow.description: Draft HTML must be generated and reviewed before the draft can replace published content.

workflow.label: Audit before publish
workflow.description: The full admin control check must pass before publishing generated files.

fields.label: Internal ID
fields.why: The ID connects the article to its source file, drafts, previews, and internal references.

fields.label: Status
fields.why: Status changes affect whether content is public, private draft, or archived.

fields.label: Title
fields.why: The visible article headline can be improved for clarity and conversion.

fields.label: SEO title
fields.why: The search-result title should be optimized without changing the article identity.

fields.label: Slug
fields.why: URL changes can break indexed pages and internal links, so slug changes must be handled by a dedicated redirect-aware tool later.

fields.label: Category
fields.why: Changing category affects breadcrumbs, category pages, internal links, sitemap grouping, and AI topic clustering.

fields.label: Meta description
fields.why: The meta description helps search engines, AI systems, and users understand the page quickly.

fields.label: Excerpt
fields.why: Excerpt text appears in lists and previews, so it can be improved safely inside a draft.

fields.label: Keywords
fields.why: Keywords support admin search, topic clustering, SEO review, and future content planning.

fields.label: Body blocks
fields.why: Article content can be revised inside a draft, then previewed and audited before publish.

fields.label: FAQ
fields.why: FAQ answers improve direct usefulness and structured-data clarity.

fields.label: Related articles
fields.why: Internal links affect navigation, crawl paths, and topical authority.

fields.label: Published date
fields.why: Published date is historical and should not change during normal edits.

fields.label: Modified date
fields.why: Modified date should update automatically when a draft is published.

fields.label: Read time
fields.why: Read time should be recalculated from article length instead of typed manually.

fields.label: CTA
fields.why: CTA links should use approved App Store campaign URLs and match the article intent.

fields.label: Canonical URL
fields.why: Canonical URL depends on the site URL and slug and should not be typed manually.
